description: Structured Rules Brain rules for PIR v4.2. These rules focus on suspected IPR, low quality, and vulgar/ANSA false-positive control for new-customer product image review.

source_context.price_rpc_current_limit: RPC currently provides min_price, max_price, and currency. For suspected_ipr v4.2, LLM may use broad world knowledge only for rough price reasonableness after a visible global famous brand/IP signal exists.

suspected_ipr.decision_policy: Only evaluate suspected_ipr for globally famous brands or globally famous IPs visible in the product image. Skip white-label, small, unknown, or ordinary store brands. After a visible famous brand/IP signal exists, use price range and broad model world knowledge to judge whether the price is clearly far below the normal official/market price level. Do not require exact official price.
visual_signals: visible globally famous brand logo or brand name
visible globally famous IP character, game, film, sports team, event, or copyrighted packaging
visible globally famous luxury, sportswear, electronics, toy/game, entertainment, or collectible IP mark
required_external_evidence: visible globally famous brand/IP signal in product image
LLM broad world-knowledge assessment of whether price is clearly below 70 percent of normal official/market price level

positive_rules.name: Global Famous Brand/IP Scope
positive_rules.rule: Only globally famous brands or globally famous IPs visible in the product image are in suspected_ipr scope. White-label, small, unknown, or ordinary store brands should be skipped.

positive_rules.name: Image-Visible Signal Required
positive_rules.rule: The brand/IP signal must be visible in the product image. Do not create suspected_ipr from product title or category alone.

positive_rules.name: 70 Percent Price Rule With World Knowledge
positive_rules.rule: If a visible global famous brand/IP signal exists and the current price range is clearly below 70 percent of the normal official/market price level based on broad model world knowledge, suspected_ipr risk increases.

false_positive_rules.name: White Label And Small Brand Exclusion
false_positive_rules.rule: Do not mark suspected_ipr for white-label, small, unknown, or ordinary store brands even if the image contains a logo or brand-like mark.

false_positive_rules.name: No Image Signal No IPR
false_positive_rules.rule: Do not mark suspected_ipr when the global famous brand/IP appears only in title, category, or model guess, but not visibly in the image.

false_positive_rules.name: Uncertain Price Knowledge
false_positive_rules.rule: If the normal official/market price level is uncertain, or if the product variant/SKU is unclear, do not apply the 70 percent rule. Route to manual_review instead.

false_positive_rules.name: Reasonable Price Range Downgrade
false_positive_rules.rule: If the price range is plausibly reasonable for the visible brand/product family, downgrade suspected_ipr risk even when a famous brand/IP signal is visible.

suspected_ipr.output_guidance: Use suspected_ipr only for globally famous brand/IP image signals. If price appears clearly below 70 percent of normal official/market price level, explain the rough price comparison. If price knowledge is uncertain, output manual_review with evidence gap instead of high-risk suspected_ipr.
not_in_scope: generic design similarities without a globally famous brand/IP signal
brand mentioned only in product title or category but not visible in image
suspected_ipr.price_assessment_policy: Use the current price range only after a visible global famous brand/IP signal exists in the image. The LLM may use broad world knowledge to estimate whether the product price is clearly below 70 percent of the normal official/market price level for that brand/product family. If the model is not confident about the normal price level, do not mark high-risk suspected_ipr; use manual_review.

low_quality.decision_policy: Only mark low_quality when the product subject is hard to recognize.

positive_rules.name: Product Subject Unrecognizable
positive_rules.rule: Mark low_quality when users cannot clearly recognize what product is being sold.

positive_rules.name: Material Obstruction
positive_rules.rule: Mark low_quality when stickers, banners, text, darkness, blur, crop, or background materially block or overwhelm the product subject.

positive_rules.name: Information Overwhelming
positive_rules.rule: Mark low_quality when excessive text/icons/graphics make the product subject difficult to identify quickly.

false_positive_rules.name: Marketing Elements Not Enough
false_positive_rules.rule: Promotional banners, TikTok Shop labels, seller badges, discount stickers, event frames, brand logos, and light watermarks are not low_quality by themselves.

false_positive_rules.name: Subject Still Clear
false_positive_rules.rule: If the product subject remains clear and identifiable, do not mark low_quality only because the image is visually busy or promotional.

false_positive_rules.name: Watermark Scope Exclusion
false_positive_rules.rule: Watermark is not a standalone in-scope issue for this workflow. Only consider it under low_quality if it materially blocks product recognition.

low_quality.output_guidance: State whether the product subject is recognizable. If yes, do not mark low_quality.

new_guest_vulgar_visual.display_name: 新客低俗色情/边缘性感画风
new_guest_vulgar_visual.decision_policy: Use this layer for new-user visual strategy intervention when the image may affect first-time user perception but does not meet strict vulgar/ANSA criteria.

positive_rules.name: New Guest Body Focus
positive_rules.rule: Buttock-focused fashion display, deep-V clothing, sexy apparel, tight leggings/shorts, and adult-oriented products can be new_guest_vulgar_visual when they are unsuitable for new-user recommendation.

positive_rules.name: Adult-Oriented Product
positive_rules.rule: Adult-oriented products or sexual-style apparel may be routed to new_guest_vulgar_visual when not explicit enough for strict vulgar/ANSA.

false_positive_rules.name: Not Strict Violation
false_positive_rules.rule: Do not label borderline sexy apparel as strict vulgar solely because it is sexy or body-fitting.

new_guest_vulgar_visual.output_guidance: Separate this from strict_vulgar_or_ansa. This is for new-user strategy intervention.

strict_vulgar_or_ansa.display_name: 严格低俗色情/成人露骨问题
strict_vulgar_or_ansa.decision_policy: Strict vulgar/ANSA requires explicit evidence, not general sexy apparel display.

positive_rules.name: Sexualized Body-Part Focus
positive_rules.rule: Mark strict vulgar when the image clearly focuses on sexualized body parts rather than product display.

positive_rules.name: Private-Part Exposure
positive_rules.rule: Mark strict vulgar/ANSA for explicit private-part exposure, clear nipple/genital/anus exposure, full nude buttocks with complete butt crack, or explicit adult nudity.

positive_rules.name: Explicit Adult Activity
positive_rules.rule: Mark ANSA for explicit sexual activity, masturbation, simulated intercourse, or explicit adult product use/display.

positive_rules.name: Clear Sexualized Graphic/Text
positive_rules.rule: Mark strict vulgar when product graphics or text clearly depict sexual acts, explicit sexualized characters, or private-part imagery.

false_positive_rules.name: Normal Apparel Display
false_positive_rules.rule: Normal apparel display, sexy clothing, deep-V clothing, leggings, shorts, swimwear, body-fit clothing, and normal underwear display are not strict vulgar by themselves.

false_positive_rules.name: Product Display Dominates
false_positive_rules.rule: If the image subject is still clearly apparel/product display and there is no explicit private-part exposure or sexual act, downgrade from strict vulgar.

false_positive_rules.name: Weak Metaphor
false_positive_rules.rule: Weak sexual metaphor or ordinary product demonstration should not be strict vulgar unless the sexual intent is explicit in composition, text, or use scenario.

strict_vulgar_or_ansa.output_guidance: If the case is borderline or only unsuitable for new users, route to new_guest_vulgar_visual instead of strict_vulgar_or_ansa.
